messages.subject: Meridian - implementation kick-off (SOW-01)
messages.plaintextBody:
Naomi,

Great to be underway. Our delivery team will run the project initiation workshop next week per SOW-01 milestone M1. Could Hartwell confirm the nominated project sponsor and project manager, and provide the validated Argus extract for migration when ready? The indicative go-live remains week 16.

Priya
